description: The plot illustrates training loss with respect to training steps for several methods. The x-axis is labeled “Steps” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1000, with tick marks every 100 steps. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1.0, with tick marks every 0.1. There are five lines displayed. The first, colored green and solid, represents “Vanilla” and starts at approximately 0.88 at step 0, decreases to 0.72 at step 100, then continues to decrease to 0.60 at step 1000. The second line, colored red and dashed, represents “SepLLM(n=380)” and begins at approximately 0.86 at step 0, decreases to 0.70 at step 100, and ends at 0.58 at step 1000. The third line, colored blue and dotted, represents “SepLLM(n=256)” and starts at 0.87 at step 0, decreases to 0.71 at step 100, and finishes at 0.59 at step 1000. The fourth line, colored orange and dash-dot, represents “SepLLM(n=64)” and begins at 0.89 at step 0, decreases to 0.73 at step 100, and ends at 0.61 at step 1000. Finally, the fifth line, colored purple and solid, represents “SepLLM(n=128)” and starts at 0.87 at step 0, decreases to 0.71 at step 100, and finishes at 0.59 at step 1000.
